name: replayowl
description: Session recording and replay with a focus on playback quality
author: replayowl <oss@replayowl.com> (https://replayowl.com)

scripts.test: PG_TEST_URL=${PG_TEST_URL:-postgres://replayowl:replayowl@127.0.0.1:15432/replayowl} sh -c 'node --test tests/unit/*.test.ts && node scripts/build.ts --demo && playwright test'
scripts.test:live: node scripts/build.ts --demo && LIVE_URLS="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Owl https://react.dev/ https://github.com/microsoft/playwright" playwright test live-site
scripts.test:s3: PG_TEST_URL=${PG_TEST_URL:-postgres://replayowl:replayowl@127.0.0.1:15432/replayowl} S3_TEST_ENDPOINT=${S3_TEST_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:19000} S3_TEST_KEY=${S3_TEST_KEY:-replayowl} S3_TEST_SECRET=${S3_TEST_SECRET:-replayowl-secret-key} sh -c 'node --test tests/unit/*.test.ts && node scripts/build.ts --demo && playwright test'
scripts.test:worker: TARGET=worker PG_TEST_URL=${PG_TEST_URL:-postgres://replayowl:replayowl@127.0.0.1:15432/replayowl} S3_TEST_ENDPOINT=${S3_TEST_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:19000} S3_TEST_KEY=${S3_TEST_KEY:-replayowl} S3_TEST_SECRET=${S3_TEST_SECRET:-replayowl-secret-key} sh -c 'node scripts/build.ts --demo && playwright test auth roundtrip search --workers 1 && WORKER_DB=pg playwright test auth roundtrip search --workers 1'
scripts.test:remote: TARGET=remote playwright test roundtrip auth search --workers 1
